source_text: A 2018 U.S. federal ruling striking down parts of the 1996 FGM ban on free exercise grounds—applied to a ritual "nicking" case—exposed this inconsistency, as similar minimal interventions on males face no such scrutiny, prompting scholarly calls for unified standards based on consent rather than sex-specific harm thresholds. [131]
